title: AccessRequestResponse
description: A *access request* object represents a request to access a shareable resource within Asana. It includes the requester's information, approval status, and target resource details.

gid.description: Globally unique identifier of the resource, as a string.

resource_type.description: The base type of this resource.

message.description: The message included in the access request, if any.
message.example: Please grant me access to this resource.

approval_status.description: The current approval status of the request.

requester.description: The user who made the access request.

target.description: The target resource that the requester wants access to.
